title: Iterator chains
description:
Answer questions about scores with iterator adapters only (no `for` loops).

```
total: 427
passed (>= 50): [72, 55, 91, 63, 80]
average of passes: 72.20
best student: Cy (91)
ranked: Cy 91, Eve 80, Ada 72, Dee 63, Bob 55, Fay 41, Gus 25
```
hints: `let mut ranked = scores.clone(); ranked.sort_by(|a, b| b.1.cmp(&a.1));` then `map(|(n, s)| format!("{n} {s}")).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(", ")`.
requirements: Sort a copy for the ranking.
stretch: Group the students into grade bands with `fold` into a `HashMap`.
